Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/primary-button", name: "Primary button", kind: Kind.section,

  options: [StringOption(name: "label", label: "Label", maxLength: 32, default: "Order now")],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
